plain_english_revision: The amendment adds a condition to unemployment eligibility: individuals living within 45 miles of a municipality with at least 1,500 residents must search for work among multiple employers; those outside this area need only find one prospective employer.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment restricts unemployment benefits by imposing a stricter job-search requirement on residents near larger municipalities while maintaining a lower threshold for those in rural areas.
evidence_quotes: if he or she resides within 45 miles of a municipality with a population of, 1,500 or more...
...or at least one prospective employer if he or she does not reside within 45 miles...
